blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Coming off a loss and with the playoffs fast approaching, George King made sure that San Miguel Beer would fix every kink in its armor. King made sure of that when he brought his laptop to show clips of what he and the rest of the Beermen can address and fine-tune moving forward in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup. And King, who dropped 44 points in San Miguel’s 135-105 rout of Terrafirma on Wednesday at Ninoy Aquino Stadium, came up with a cliché when asked about the importance of watching film. “Film does not lie.
